dialogChoices: I'm in search of a quest.
title: Shield of Arrav

steps: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library: "I'm in search of a quest."
Find the book on the top shelf of the bookcase with the bright blue book and read it.
Choose a gang: the Phoenix Gang or the Black Arm Gang. Your partner takes the other one, so agree in advance (the chat channel "osrs soa"). Both halves of the shield are collected by the two of you.
Phoenix Gang: ask the fur trader Baraek in Varrock Square where to find the Phoenix Gang (pay 20 coins).
Phoenix Gang: go to the hideout in the south-east part of the city: a house with a staircase to the basement, west of the Mage of Zamorak altar.
Phoenix Gang: talk to Straven ("I know who you are!", "I'd like to offer you my services.").
Phoenix Gang: kill Jonny the beard in the Blue Moon Inn tavern and bring Straven the Intel report.
Phoenix Gang: open the chest in the south-west corner of the hideout for half of the shield.
Phoenix Gang: pass your partner the key (Weapon store key).
Black Arm Gang: talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock.
Black Arm Gang: go into the alley to the west and into the Black Arm Gang headquarters, and talk to Katrine ("I want to become a member of your gang.").
Black Arm Gang: get the key (Weapon store key) from your partner, open the door in the south-east corner of the city with it (next to the building with the Chaos Altar) and climb the stairs.
Black Arm Gang: kill the Weaponsmaster or take both Phoenix crossbows with Telekinetic Grab, and take both crossbows to Katrine.
Black Arm Gang: upstairs in the headquarters open the cupboard south of the stairs for the second half of the shield.
Take your half of the shield to the curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum.
Swap halves of the certificate with your partner and join both (Use them on each other).
Hand the certificate to King Roald in the castle: the quest is complete.
